test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: The arc length of a sector of a circle that subtends a 22.5° angle at the centre is given as 16.5 cm. What will be the radius (in cm) of the circle? [Use π = (22)/(7)]
solution:
Given:

Arc length = 16.5 cm

Angle subtended by Arc = 22.5°

The radius of the circle = r

Formula used:

The angle subtended by an arc (in Radian) = (Length of arc)/Radius

The arc length of a sector = (θ/360°) × 2πr

Calculation:

(θ/360°) × 2πr = 16.5

⇒ 22.5/360 ×(22/7 × r) = 16.5

⇒ r/14 = 3

⇒ r = 42 cm

∴ The radius of the circle is 42cm.
